reason: I'm home with a toddler all week and need somewhere calm to go that isn't a germy chain play place, and I can work on my laptop with coffee and Wi-Fi while she plays. The free first visit makes it easy to try, and the cleaning log speaks to my main worry.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth, and a posted log is only worth something if staff really follow it. Also it's not open yet, so I'm judging a promise.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the cleaning routine in person on the free first visit (toys wiped between kids, a real log, a clean Baby Nook). If it looked grubby I wouldn't come back.
